mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stat_daily_spu_sales ( id, tenant_id, stat_date, spu_id, buyer_cnt, repeat_buyer_cnt, repurchase_rate, create_time, update_time ) SELECT REPLACE(UUID(), '-', ''), #{tenantId}, #{statDate}, t.spu_id, COUNT(*) AS buyer_cnt, IFNULL(SUM(t.order_cnt >= 2), 0) AS repeat_buyer_cnt, IFNULL(ROUND(SUM(t.order_cnt >= 2) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2), 0) AS repurchase_rate, NOW(), NOW() FROM ( SELECT i.spu_id AS spu_id, o.user_id AS user_id, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_cnt FROM order_item AS i INNER JOIN order_info AS o ON o.id = i.order_id AND o.tenant_id = i.tenant_id AND o.del_flag = '0' AND o.status IN ('2', '3', '4') AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) WHERE i.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND i.del_flag = '0' AND o.user_id IS NOT NULL AND o.user_id != '' GROUP BY i.spu_id, o.user_id ) t GROUP BY t.spu_id ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE buyer_cnt = VALUES(buyer_cnt), repeat_buyer_cnt = VALUES(repeat_buyer_cnt), repurchase_rate = VALUES(repurchase_rate), update_time = NOW()
mapper.select: SELECT s.spu_id AS spuId, s.buyer_cnt AS buyerCnt, s.repeat_buyer_cnt AS repeatBuyerCnt, s.repurchase_rate AS repurchaseRate FROM stat_daily_spu_sales AS s INNER JOIN ( SELECT spu_id, MAX(stat_date) AS max_date FROM stat_daily_spu_sales WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND stat_date <= CURDATE() AND spu_id IN #{spuId} GROUP BY spu_id ) m ON m.spu_id = s.spu_id AND m.max_date = s.stat_date WHERE s.tenant_id = #{tenantId}
